messages:
Jules M: NOVA ROBOTICS (acct: NOVA-88) invoice INV-4477 for $34,250 is 75 days past due. Multiple dunning emails bounced and phone goes to voicemail.
Lina R: Ugh. Any contractual terms? Net-30 in SOW. Renewal noted account is expanding so we want to be careful.
BillingBot: Autopay: no card on file. Last sent invoice link: https://pay.redwood.ai/inv/INV-4477. Final reminder sent.
Jules M: I pulled the contact: payables@novarobotics.io but replies to that address have been auto-replies. CS says AM spoke to executive last week who promised to "sort finance this week" but no confirmation.
AM - Omar: I spoke with their VP Ops. They said treasury is in a hiring freeze and cashflows are delayed. Asked if we can do a 90-day interest-bearing plan or accept an exec-signed promissory note.
Lina R: 90 days seems long. Options: 1) 3-installment 60 days, 2) 90 days with 1.5% interest, or 3) immediate partial wire (40%) and remainder on 30 days. Which protects revenue best?
Sam R (Legal): We can accept a promissory note or signed payment plan. If choosing interest-bearing plan, we should document rate and acceleration clause. Legal prefers a signed promissory + exec guarantee for >60 days.
Jules M: Proposed approach: offer two choices to customer: 
- Option A: 3 installments over 60 days (no interest) with ACH/wire only
- Option B: 90-day single maturity with 1.5% fee and signed promissory note from execs
Require signed acknowledgement and if they miss any payment, full balance becomes due and collections may restart.
BillingBot: Draft invoice INV-4477-PLAN created. Payment link updated.
AM - Omar: I'll run options by their CFO and ask for exec sign-off if they pick Option B. Also requested PO so we can reissue if needed.
Lina R: If they pick Option A we'll pause collections outreach. If Option B we should keep collections paused but mark higher risk and require guarantee.
CollectionsBot: Collections outreach paused pending signed plan. Reminder scheduled for follow-up in 14 days.
Jules M: Sent plan to payables@novarobotics.io and cc'd ask their CFO and legal. Included deadline for acceptance of 5 business days.
BillingBot: Incoming message from payables@novarobotics.io: "We can do Option A but can only pay 30% now, 35% in 30 days, 35% in 60 days. Can you accept that split?"
Lina R: That's slightly different weighting but close. We can accept 30/35/35 if they pay the first installment within 5 business days and provide signed plan. No discounts and ACH preferred.
Sam R (Legal): Acceptable. Document with signed ack. Add clause: missed installment triggers acceleration of remaining balance.
AM - Omar: Customer sent signed plan and wire confirmation for first installment. Wire ETA 2 business days. Exec included on thread.
BillingBot: Wire scheduled: $10,275 (30% of $34,250) (txn: SCHED-99012).
Jules M: Good. Please confirm when wire posts; I'll update ledger and remove suspension threat.
BillingBot: Payment posted: $10,275 (txn: WIRE-99012). Remaining balance: $23,975.
Lina R: Received. Restoring service and updating account notes with signed plan. Set reminders for 30-day and 60-day payments.
CollectionsBot: Collections hold remains until next due date. Reminder set for follow-up on 1744264321. If installment missed, automatic escalation to Collections Partner.
Jules M: Thanks everyone. Closing current escalation. If the second payment misses, we'll reconvene and consider collections/legal escalation. :thumbsup:
